title: apoc deployment failing: disk space on remote host
description: nixos-rebuild switch for apoc failed during remote build. Two derivations failed with 'builder failed with exit code 1' and note 'build failure may have been caused by lack of free disk space': /nix/store/gyia21ljgz2yf770ar42r41gnnifnnh4-NetworkManager.conf.drv and /nix/store/2xxm6zs7d134l5qhjldqyc8zn3bsqn2n-xkb-validated.drv. Investigate disk usage on apoc, clean up if needed, and retry deploy.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Confirm root cause (disk space vs build bug); 2. Free space or fix build environment on apoc; 3. Successful nixos-rebuild switch for apoc
close_reason: Freed 17.1 GiB with nix-collect-garbage -d on apoc; subsequent just nixos-switch apoc succeeded.

title: Fix just clean shell escaping
description: The remote-host loop in just clean used Make-style 53597 escaping, causing the shell to receive 53597(...) and fail before cleaning apoc. Replace with normal shell variable syntax.
close_reason: Fixed just clean shell loop escaping and verified remote apoc cleanup succeeds; apoc now has 32G free.

title: ghostty opens in background from KDE launcher icon
description: ghostty launches but does not come to foreground / get focus when opened from the KDE application menu icon. Likely ghostty's single-instance behavior or GTK focus issue under KDE. Investigate and fix via ghostty config or wrapper/desktop entry.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Identify root cause (single-instance vs focus/raise); 2. Apply fix (config or wrapper); 3. Verify ghostty opens in foreground from icon after deploy
close_reason: Added ~/.config/ghostty/config for fs@apoc with gtk-single-instance=false to prevent ghostty from opening behind existing windows when launched from KDE icon. nix flake check --no-build passed.

title: ghostty fails on apoc VM due to OpenGL 4.3 requirement
description: ghostty was added to apoc desktop packages but fails to launch on the Parallels VM. Error: 'OpenGL version is too old. Ghostty requires OpenGL 4.3'. The VM reports OpenGL 4.0. Need to decide: remove ghostty from apoc, keep it for future hardware migration, or configure software rendering if supported.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Confirm root cause (VM GPU lacks OpenGL 4.3); 2. Decide resolution (remove/keep/workaround); 3. Apply chosen fix and verify
close_reason: Removed ghostty from hosts/modules/packages/linux/desktop.nix because Parallels VM only exposes OpenGL 4.0 and ghostty requires 4.3. Recommended konsole (already installed via KDE) as the native alternative. nix flake check --no-build passed.

notes: User confirmed Citrix Extend all displays likely recreates macOS native fullscreen; without it Citrix is single-screen. Need determine whether AeroSpace can truly ignore Citrix native fullscreen or whether workflow requires choosing between Citrix all-displays and AeroSpace management.

title: Float Citrix in AeroSpace

Existing Citrix windows are macOS native fullscreen, so AeroSpace cannot change their layout live; rule applies to newly created/non-native-fullscreen Citrix windows.

title: Fix AeroSpace apps floating after Citrix spaces change
description: After enabling spans-displays, Citrix works but apps are no longer being assigned to AeroSpace workspaces and appear floating. Inspect AeroSpace server/config/window state and apply the smallest fix.
notes: After logout/login and enabling Accessibility + Screen Recording, AeroSpace still lists apps but list-windows is empty. Reinstall/downgrade/upgrade tested. Active config matches repo baseline. WindowServer probe via CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo reports only Citrix Viewer layer-0 windows on screen, even while list-apps includes Telegram/TextEdit/Safari/Brave. Likely Citrix all-screens/native fullscreen is monopolizing the visible macOS Space; next verification is to exit/disconnect Citrix all-screens or quit Citrix Viewer, then restart AeroSpace and check list-windows.
close_reason: AeroSpace window detection restored after full reboot. Verified list-windows is populated, permissions are allowed, active config matches repo baseline, and callbacks place visible windows on configured workspaces: Brave/Safari on B and Citrix Viewer on W. Telegram rule remains present for ru.keepcoder.Telegram -> M; needs an open Telegram window for direct verification.

title: Reinvestigate Citrix AeroSpace jump after spans-displays

title: Investigate Citrix AeroSpace workspace jump
description: Citrix is used on workspace W with all displays enabled, but clicking the right-side screen makes it jump to workspace T. Inspect live AeroSpace window metadata and routing rules, then apply the smallest config fix if needed.
close_reason: Root cause: Citrix Viewer was using macOS native fullscreen across displays while macOS had separate Spaces per display enabled, so the right monitor stayed on its own visible AeroSpace workspace. Added system.defaults.spaces.spans-displays = true for neo, applied with just darwin-switch neo, and verified defaults read com.apple.spaces spans-displays returns 1. Full behavioral verification requires logout/login and retesting Citrix.

title: Re-add ghostty to apoc with software rendering wrapper
description: Assessment: the shared advice is correct — Mesa's LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 forces llvmpipe software rendering, which advertises OpenGL 4.5 and should satisfy ghostty's OpenGL 4.3 requirement inside the Parallels VM. Implement ghostty on apoc via a wrapper that sets this env var so it launches cleanly from app drawer and shell.
acceptance_criteria: 1. ghostty re-added to apoc in a way that avoids OpenGL 4.0 limitation; 2. nix flake check --no-build passes; 3. ghostty launches without OpenGL errors in VM
close_reason: Re-added ghostty to apoc desktop packages via symlinkJoin wrapper that sets LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1, forcing Mesa software rendering (OpenGL 4.5 via llvmpipe) to bypass Parallels VM's OpenGL 4.0 limit. nix flake check --no-build passed; wrapped ghostty confirmed in apoc system packages.
